features.alt: 66% less RAM, 87% fewer prompt tokens, 2.2x faster MiniMax-H3-Image
features.title: Leaner and faster
features.summary: GGUF image models load with up to 66% less RAM, and MCP chats send up to 87% fewer prompt tokens.

improved: Renders a new prompt in 36.7 s on 8 GB GPUs, down from 82.7 s.
GGUF image models load with 52 to 66% less RAM on Linux and macOS.
MCP chats process 83 to 87% fewer prompt tokens.
FLUX.1 takes 16 to 28% less time per step when streaming from RAM.
fixed: GTX 16xx cards no longer fail renders with a NaN error.
